summary: The corrective #2879 EC revision preserves the accepted two-hop KSA/RBAC, source-built GKE provenance, cleanup, evidence-integrity, and independent redaction contracts while restoring ordinary direct harness compatibility. The source preflight requires both the exact executable audit-and-destroy function and an exact strict pair guard: neither auditor variable bypasses the optional EC callback, exactly one fails, and both invoke the reviewed auditor before immediately deleting and clearing SECRET_DIR. Comment-only, half-configured, unguarded standalone invocation, and unsafe work between audit and destruction are rejected. The inspected harness keeps credential material in SECRET_DIR, so this boundary remains materially sufficient rather than a regex-only false green. `applicability = cb` is semantically required because the callback and production source-built service must exist before this case can verify them. The missing production callback remains a specific post-code obligation and causes the EC runner to fail before starting GKE.
